dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent in Dikwa Town, Dikwa Local Government Area, Borno state, Nigeria as of 9 and 19 September 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240902NGA** This map illustrates the satellite-detected accumulated flood extent in Dikwa Town, Dikwa Local Government Area, Borno State, Nigeria. as observed from Sentinel-2 images acquired on 9 and 19 September 2024. Within analysed areas of about 200 km², a total of about 30 km² of lands appear to be affected with flood waters. UNITAR-UNOSAT identified about 1,060 potentially affected structures, along with a potentially affected road extending about 26 km within the analysed area. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
